author: OpenBank Security
notes: Verified 2026-10-05 against current-source card-processing runtimeClasspath, its built fast-jar and its 330-component CycloneDX SBOM. Trivy 0.74.0 reported CVE-2025-14969 on the exact Hibernate Reactive artifact. This review does not cover the deployed container's OS packages; retain their findings under investigation until that image is scanned. Reassess on artifact or scanner-database changes.

statements.impact_statement: Card-processing's built fast-jar contains org.hibernate.reactive:hibernate-reactive-core 3.4.2.Final with SHA-256 7e7443b2b5313b043af3d9448499f44059fa77729ddb9e369c4a2b9a9cea075c, matching gradle/verification-metadata.xml. Disassembly of this artifact shows the upstream fix cd7f104e10de918004707ca0e26e3840976f780a: SqlClientConnection.close() calls validateNoTransactionInProgressOnClose(), the class has the post-fix closed field, and Log declares liveTransactionDetectedOnClose(). The advisory's <4.2.1 version range spans parallel release lines; the vulnerable close implementation is absent from this resolved artifact.
